actions.label: Calculate distilled water Rf values

interaction.successCue: distilled water Rf values are calculated from recorded distances.
interaction.invalidCue: Record the solvent front and every observed band before calculating Rf.

nodes.description: Suspend the dried strip in the open chromatography-solvent chamber with its lower edge in the solvent layer and the pencil origin above it. The lid has to be off to reach inside.

validation.label: Suspend chromatography-solvent paper in the open chamber was completed.

hints: Open the chamber and keep the origin above the configured solvent layer before suspending the strip.

feedback.success: Suspend chromatography-solvent paper in the open chamber complete.
feedback.retry: Open the chamber and keep the origin above the configured solvent layer before suspending the strip.

nodes.title: Close the chromatography-solvent chamber lid
nodes.description: Seat the lid on the chromatography-solvent chamber. The container has to be sealed so the solvent saturates the paper instead of evaporating first.

validation.label: Close the chromatography-solvent chamber lid notebook evidence was recorded.

hints: Review the current chromatography step and try again.

feedback.success: Close the chromatography-solvent chamber lid complete.
feedback.retry: Review the current chromatography step and try again.

nodes.title: Develop chromatography-solvent chromatogram in the sealed chamber
nodes.description: Leave the sealed chromatography-solvent chamber undisturbed until the approved stop condition. The strip is already suspended with its origin above the solvent and the lid is already closed.

validation.label: Develop chromatography-solvent chromatogram in the sealed chamber was completed.

hints: Development acts on a chamber that is already loaded and sealed. Complete the suspend and close steps for the chromatography-solvent trial first.

feedback.success: Develop chromatography-solvent chromatogram in the sealed chamber complete.
feedback.retry: Development acts on a chamber that is already loaded and sealed. Complete the suspend and close steps for the chromatography-solvent trial first.

nodes.title: Open the chromatography-solvent chamber lid
nodes.description: Lift the lid off the chromatography-solvent chamber so the developed strip can be taken out. The chromatogram on the strip is unchanged by opening the chamber.

validation.label: Open the chromatography-solvent chamber lid notebook evidence was recorded.

hints: Review the current chromatography step and try again.

feedback.success: Open the chromatography-solvent chamber lid complete.
feedback.retry: Review the current chromatography step and try again.

commonMistakes.when: baseline is marked with soluble ink
commonMistakes.message: Use pencil for the baseline so the line does not dissolve.
commonMistakes.recovery: Mark the baseline with pencil before spotting.

commonMistakes.when: spot is below the solvent surface
commonMistakes.message: The sample spot must stay above the solvent.
commonMistakes.recovery: Use a shallow solvent layer and suspend the paper carefully.

commonMistakes.when: the paper dries before the solvent front is marked
commonMistakes.message: An unmarked front leaves every Rf without a denominator.
commonMistakes.recovery: Mark the front as the strip leaves the chamber; otherwise repeat the trial.

commonMistakes.when: distances are read before the marked paper dries
commonMistakes.message: Wet bands keep migrating, so the reading is not the band centre.
commonMistakes.recovery: Dry the marked strip flat, then align the ruler on the origin.
